name: The Wondrous Wisdomball offers a Human only the Scarlet Monastery quests their race may take (#8258)
contract: Issue #8258 reported that a Human character was offered Horde quests at the Wondrous Wisdomball. Since #9501, AscensionWisdomball.cpp's CanOffer requires Player::SatisfyQuestRace, and the ball's accept path goes through CanOffer too. Scarlet Monastery (map 189, QuestSortID 796) has Alliance quests (AllowableRaces 1101: 1053 In the Name of the Light, 1050 Mythology of the Titans) and Horde quests (AllowableRaces 690: 1048 Into The Scarlet Monastery, 1051 Vorrel's Revenge, 1113 Hearts of Zeal). A Human (race 1) is offered the Alliance quests and none of the Horde ones, and a hostile client accept of a Horde quest at the ball is refused.

steps.label: Obtain the companion, as a purchase would
Using the item teaches its summon
Summon the ball in Scarlet Monastery
The cast produced a creature this Human owns
The Alliance In the Name of the Light is offered
The Alliance Mythology of the Titans is offered
The Horde Into The Scarlet Monastery is not offered
The Horde Vorrel's Revenge is not offered
The Horde Hearts of Zeal is not offered
Try to take Hearts of Zeal anyway, as a hostile client would
The ball refuses it - it never enters the log
Take the Alliance In the Name of the Light
The Alliance quest enters the Human's log
